card.name: Climate advocacy calls to action
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as at, to, and, by right after verbs or nouns of effort in climate and environmental advocacy text, where an action or goal is about to be named.

modes.label: Goal-linking words
modes.description: Words like at or to that lead into the goal of climate action.
modes.example: projects aimed<< at>> addressing climate and sustainability issues in their community

modes.label: Struggle or must-do phrasing
modes.description: The word to after struggle or have, introducing what must be faced.
modes.example: while we all struggle<< to>> face the challenges of global warming

modes.label: Paired nouns in policy
modes.description: Words inside pairs such as policy and technology, or step by step.
modes.example: how policy and<< technology>> decisions made today will matter

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words of urgency and calls to act, such as urgent, urgently and desperately.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words in climate-activism writing just before the text says what must be done.
